profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Richmond, California, that provides mindfulness and social-emotional learning programs in schools. It works mainly with elementary and middle schools that receive Title I funding. The programs support the mental and emotional wellness of students, teachers, staff, leaders and families.

sources.title: Mindful Life Project - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Name and Richmond, CA location match the agenda; ProPublica confirms the 501(c)(3) and EIN 47-5066819, and the organization's about and contact pages confirm the school-based mindfulness/SEL work, phone, email and address. The summary is neutral and supported (TK-8 Title I schools); the sources do not mention Oakland, but the service type fits OUSD's school-based contracts.
